entities.summary: Yekaterina Dmitriyevna Kuskova was economist, journalist, and politician from the Russian Empire involved in founding both the Russian Social-Democratic Workers' Party (RSDRP) and the liberal Constitutional Democratic Party. She was an advocate of social reformism and opposed the Bolsheviks.
